rubricDispositions.rationale: The pure commit seam compares proposal.workspaceId, brainKey, and pageKey against the current context before returning any revision effect, and the focused test proves a mismatched workspace throws StaleRevision.

The workflow contract is internal-only and requires a system caller whose surface is workflow or internal before start/status/approve execute. Autopilot eligibility also requires adminEnabled, but no public workflow controls are exposed in this task delta.
Lifecycle revocation is checked during gather, request, and commit, including commit-time review acceptance and gathered input coverage.

The reviewed maintenance code has no logging or raw provider payload emission. It stores citation keys and proposal markdown rather than secrets, and the public capability currently returns only fixture proposal metadata and citation keys.

Commit freshness checks revision plus route/lifecycle/policy generations and the model prompt pair before publishing; stale revisions throw and changed model/prompt pairs downgrade to awaiting_review.
Duplicate review attempt keys are rejected at the commit seam, and the durable table includes idempotency/review-attempt fields plus workspace-scoped idempotency indexes for persistence fencing.
Citation membership, citation-required, budget, self-confidence, lifecycle, prompt-injection, and Autopilot eligibility fences are enforced by pure policy helpers and focused tests.
The task delta keeps maintenance logic pure/fixture-backed and does not import live LLM/provider SDKs or server secret environment variables into capability, workflow, or web surfaces.
